source.text_it: Il servodeviatore modulato garantisce la frenatura del rimorchio anche in caso di avaria del tubo moderabile

records.localized_text: The modulated diverter valve ensures trailer braking even if the control line fails.

source.text_it: Il servodeviatore modulato simula l'avaria del tubo automatico, quando invece si è verificata l’avaria del tubo moderabile

records.localized_text: The modulated diverter valve simulates an automatic-line failure when the control line has actually failed.

source.text_it: Il servodeviatore modulato innesca la frenatura automatica in caso di avaria del tubo moderabile

records.localized_text: The modulated diverter valve triggers automatic braking if the control line fails.

source.text_it: Il servodeviatore modulato è montato sulla motrice

records.localized_text: The modulated diverter valve is mounted on the powered vehicle.

source.text_it: Il servodeviatore modulato è posto a valle del servodistributore a triplo comando

records.localized_text: The modulated diverter valve is downstream of the triple-control relay valve.

source.text_it: Dal servodeviatore modulato partono i tubi automatico e moderabile

records.localized_text: The automatic and control lines leave the modulated diverter valve.

source.text_it: Il servodeviatore modulato non è necessario su una motrice non atta al traino

records.localized_text: A modulated diverter valve is unnecessary on a powered vehicle not equipped for towing.

source.text_it: Il servoautodistributore è montato sul rimorchio

records.localized_text: The trailer relay emergency valve is mounted on the trailer.

source.text_it: Al servoautodistributore sono collegati in ingresso due tubi, quello del moderabile e quello dell’automatico

records.localized_text: Two inlet lines connect to the trailer relay emergency valve: the control and automatic lines.

source.text_it: Dal servoautodistributore sono collegati in uscita due tubi, uno che va al serbatoio del rimorchio e uno agli elementi frenanti

records.localized_text: Two outlet lines connect to the trailer relay emergency valve, one to the trailer tank and one to the brake components.

source.text_it: Il servoautodistributore garantisce la frenatura istantanea ed automatica del rimorchio in caso di sganciamento accidentale

records.localized_text: The trailer relay emergency valve ensures instant automatic trailer braking if it accidentally uncouples.

source.text_it: Nel servoautodistributore esiste un comando manuale per lo sblocco dei freni di stazionamento del rimorchio quando lo stesso è sganciato dalla motrice

records.localized_text: The trailer relay emergency valve has a manual control for releasing the trailer parking brakes when uncoupled.

source.text_it: Il servoautodistributore è dotato di una valvola di ritenuta, una di scarico e una d'immissione

records.localized_text: The trailer relay emergency valve has a check valve, an exhaust valve and an inlet valve.

source.text_it: Nel servoautodistributore, la valvola d'immissione resta aperta finché viene premuto il pedale del freno

records.localized_text: In the trailer relay emergency valve, the inlet valve remains open while the brake pedal is pressed.

source.text_it: Nell'impianto di frenatura pneumatico, il servodistributore a triplo comando garantisce la frenatura del rimorchio in caso di avaria del tubo moderabile

records.localized_text: In a pneumatic braking system, the triple-control relay valve ensures trailer braking if the control line fails.

source.text_it: Nell'impianto di frenatura pneumatico, il servodistributore a triplo comando, garantisce la frenatura del rimorchio in caso di avaria del tubo automatico

records.localized_text: In a pneumatic braking system, the triple-control relay valve ensures trailer braking if the automatic line fails.

source.text_it: La frenatura di soccorso del servodistributore a triplo comando garantisce la frenatura del rimorchio in caso di guasto del tubo moderabile

records.localized_text: Emergency braking by the triple-control relay valve ensures trailer braking if the control line fails.

source.text_it: Nell'impianto di frenatura pneumatico, il servodeviatore modulato è posto sul rimorchio

records.localized_text: In a pneumatic braking system, the modulated diverter valve is located on the trailer.

source.text_it: Quando per un'avaria non funziona una sezione dell’impianto frenante della motrice, il servoautodistributore garantisce comunque la frenatura del rimorchio

records.localized_text: If a section of the powered vehicle's braking system fails, the trailer relay emergency valve still ensures trailer braking.

source.text_it: Quando, per un'avaria, non funziona una sezione dell’impianto di frenatura della motrice, il servodeviatore modulato garantisce ugualmente la frenatura del rimorchio

records.localized_text: If a section of the powered vehicle's braking system fails, the modulated diverter valve still ensures trailer braking.

source.text_it: Quando, per un'avaria, si svuota durante la marcia il tubo automatico, il servodistributore a triplo comando svuota immediatamente il tubo moderabile

records.localized_text: If a fault empties the automatic line while driving, the triple-control relay valve immediately empties the control line.

source.text_it: Quando, per un'avaria, si svuota durante la marcia il tubo automatico, il servodistributore a triplo comando garantisce comunque la frenatura del rimorchio

records.localized_text: If a fault empties the automatic line while driving, the triple-control relay valve still ensures trailer braking.

source.text_it: Il modulatore di pressione in funzione del carico può essere montato sia sui rimorchi che sulle motrici

records.localized_text: A load-dependent pressure modulator may be fitted to trailers and powered vehicles.

source.text_it: Il modulatore di pressione in funzione del carico è montato sul telaio ed è collegato con una leva all'assale

records.localized_text: The load-dependent pressure modulator is mounted on the chassis and connected to the axle by a lever.

source.text_it: Il modulatore di pressione in funzione del carico garantisce la progressività della frenata col variare del carico

records.localized_text: The load-dependent pressure modulator ensures progressive braking as load changes.

rows.text: If the control line breaks, applying the tractor brakes causes the modulated diverter valve to reduce supply-line pressure proportionally, bringing on the trailer brakes.
evidence: https://www.serformazione.it/data/uploads/docs/3974EA7E-9E39-11EC-92F1-41634E5F79CB.pdf — § 241.7.2, p. 24, e funzionamento (13), pp. 52–53: con avaria della moderabile la frenatura del rimorchio accompagna quella della motrice tramite la riduzione della pressione nella condotta automatica.

rows.text: If the control line fails, applying the tractor brakes causes the modulated diverter valve to reduce supply-line pressure proportionally, so the trailer reacts as if the supply line had failed.
evidence: https://www.serformazione.it/data/uploads/docs/3974EA7E-9E39-11EC-92F1-41634E5F79CB.pdf — § 241.7.2, p. 24, e funzionamento (13), pp. 52–53: con avaria della moderabile la frenatura del rimorchio accompagna quella della motrice tramite la riduzione della pressione nella condotta automatica.

rows.text: If the control line fails, applying the tractor brakes causes the modulated diverter valve to reduce supply-line pressure proportionally and trigger automatic trailer braking.
evidence: https://www.serformazione.it/data/uploads/docs/3974EA7E-9E39-11EC-92F1-41634E5F79CB.pdf — § 241.7.2, p. 24, e funzionamento (13), pp. 52–53: con avaria della moderabile la frenatura del rimorchio accompagna quella della motrice tramite la riduzione della pressione nella condotta automatica.

rows.text: The modulated diverter valve is on the towing vehicle and controls the lines leading to the trailer.
evidence: https://www.serformazione.it/data/uploads/docs/3974EA7E-9E39-11EC-92F1-41634E5F79CB.pdf — § 241.7.2 e funzionamento (13), pp. 24 e 53: posizione, collegamenti e intervento del servodeviatore.

rows.text: In this system the modulated diverter valve receives its signal from the triple-control valve, so it is downstream of it.
evidence: https://www.serformazione.it/data/uploads/docs/3974EA7E-9E39-11EC-92F1-41634E5F79CB.pdf — § 241.7.2 e funzionamento (13), pp. 24 e 53: posizione, collegamenti e intervento del servodeviatore.

rows.text: Two lines run from the modulated diverter valve to the couplings: the supply line feeds the trailer and the control line commands its brakes.
evidence: https://www.serformazione.it/data/uploads/docs/3974EA7E-9E39-11EC-92F1-41634E5F79CB.pdf — § 241.7.2 e funzionamento (13), pp. 24 e 53: posizione, collegamenti e intervento del servodeviatore.

rows.text: The modulated diverter valve manages the brake lines to the trailer; a vehicle not equipped to tow does not need this connection.
evidence: https://www.serformazione.it/data/uploads/docs/3974EA7E-9E39-11EC-92F1-41634E5F79CB.pdf — § 241.7.2 e funzionamento (13), pp. 24 e 53: posizione, collegamenti e intervento del servodeviatore.

rows.text: The trailer relay emergency valve is fixed to the trailer frame and manages its air supply and braking.
evidence: https://www.serformazione.it/data/uploads/docs/3974EA7E-9E39-11EC-92F1-41634E5F79CB.pdf — § 241.8 e 241.8.1, pp. 25–26 e funzionamento (15), pp. 54–55: collegamenti e frenatura del rimorchio.

rows.text: The trailer relay emergency valve receives both the supply line and the control line from the towing vehicle.
evidence: https://www.serformazione.it/data/uploads/docs/3974EA7E-9E39-11EC-92F1-41634E5F79CB.pdf — § 241.8 e 241.8.1, pp. 25–26 e funzionamento (15), pp. 54–55: collegamenti e frenatura del rimorchio.

rows.text: The trailer relay emergency valve connects the supply line to the trailer reservoir and sends air to the brake actuators when required.
evidence: https://www.serformazione.it/data/uploads/docs/3974EA7E-9E39-11EC-92F1-41634E5F79CB.pdf — § 241.8 e 241.8.1, pp. 25–26 e funzionamento (15), pp. 54–55: collegamenti e frenatura del rimorchio.

rows.text: If the trailer becomes detached, the supply line loses pressure and the trailer relay emergency valve sends reservoir air to the trailer brakes.
evidence: https://www.serformazione.it/data/uploads/docs/3974EA7E-9E39-11EC-92F1-41634E5F79CB.pdf — § 241.8 e 241.8.1, pp. 25–26 e funzionamento (15), pp. 54–55: collegamenti e frenatura del rimorchio.

rows.text: In this system the manual control releases the brakes of the detached trailer by exhausting air from the brake actuators.
evidence: https://www.serformazione.it/data/uploads/docs/3974EA7E-9E39-11EC-92F1-41634E5F79CB.pdf — § 241.8 e 241.8.1, pp. 25–26 e funzionamento (15), pp. 54–55: collegamenti e frenatura del rimorchio.

rows.text: The check valve retains air in the reservoir; the inlet valve sends it to the brakes and the exhaust valve allows them to release.
evidence: https://www.serformazione.it/data/uploads/docs/3974EA7E-9E39-11EC-92F1-41634E5F79CB.pdf — § 241.8 e 241.8.1, pp. 25–26 e funzionamento (15), pp. 54–55: collegamenti e frenatura del rimorchio.

rows.text: The inlet valve does not necessarily stay open throughout braking: in the WABCO example it closes at equilibrium during partial braking, while it remains open during full braking.
evidence: WABCO Systems and Components https://www.wabco-customercentre.com/catalog/docs/8150100823.pdf §5.57 printed pp.215–216, valve 971 002: inlet closes at equilibrium in partial braking and remains open during full braking.

rows.text: If the control line fails, the modulated diverter valve protects the trailer: when the tractor is braked, it proportionally reduces supply-line pressure and activates the trailer brakes.
evidence: https://www.serformazione.it/data/uploads/docs/3974EA7E-9E39-11EC-92F1-41634E5F79CB.pdf — § 241.7.2, p. 24, e funzionamento (13), pp. 52–53: con avaria della moderabile la frenatura del rimorchio accompagna quella della motrice tramite la riduzione della pressione nella condotta automatica.

rows.text: If the supply line loses pressure, the relay emergency valve on the trailer responds; the resulting automatic braking is not caused by the triple-control valve.
evidence: https://www.serformazione.it/data/uploads/docs/3974EA7E-9E39-11EC-92F1-41634E5F79CB.pdf — § 241.8 e 241.8.1, pp. 25–26 e funzionamento (15), pp. 54–55: collegamenti e frenatura del rimorchio.

rows.text: The triple-control valve allows braking when one towing-vehicle brake circuit fails; the modulated diverter valve responds to control-line failure.
evidence: https://www.serformazione.it/data/uploads/docs/3974EA7E-9E39-11EC-92F1-41634E5F79CB.pdf — § 241.7.1–241.7.2, pp. 23–24: funzioni distinte del triplo comando e del servodeviatore.

rows.text: The modulated diverter valve is on the towing vehicle, downstream of the triple-control valve; the relay emergency valve is on the trailer.
evidence: https://www.serformazione.it/data/uploads/docs/3974EA7E-9E39-11EC-92F1-41634E5F79CB.pdf — § 241.7.2 e funzionamento (13), pp. 24 e 53: posizione, collegamenti e intervento del servodeviatore.

rows.text: When one service-brake circuit on the towing vehicle fails, the triple-control valve maintains the trailer braking command.
evidence: https://www.serformazione.it/data/uploads/docs/3974EA7E-9E39-11EC-92F1-41634E5F79CB.pdf — § 241.7.1–241.7.2, pp. 23–24: funzioni distinte del triplo comando e del servodeviatore.

rows.text: The modulated diverter valve responds to control-line failure; when one towing-vehicle service-brake circuit fails, the triple-control valve maintains the command.
evidence: https://www.serformazione.it/data/uploads/docs/3974EA7E-9E39-11EC-92F1-41634E5F79CB.pdf — § 241.7.1–241.7.2, pp. 23–24: funzioni distinte del triplo comando e del servodeviatore.

rows.text: In the illustrated WABCO system, loss of the supply line triggers automatic trailer braking using air from the trailer reservoir. Supply and control are separate lines; this alone does not determine control-line pressure.
evidence: WABCO https://www.wabco-customercentre.com/catalog/docs/8150100823.pdf §5.57 printed pp.215–216: supply loss vents port 1 and reservoir air flows through brake outputs in illustrated 971 002; no control-line pressure state inferred.

rows.text: When the supply line loses pressure, the relay emergency valve uses air from the trailer reservoir to brake it; the triple-control valve does not cause this automatic braking.
evidence: https://www.serformazione.it/data/uploads/docs/3974EA7E-9E39-11EC-92F1-41634E5F79CB.pdf — § 241.8 e 241.8.1, pp. 25–26 e funzionamento (15), pp. 54–55: collegamenti e frenatura del rimorchio.

rows.text: The load-sensing valve adjusts brake pressure to the load and can be fitted to either the towing vehicle or the trailer.
evidence: https://www.serformazione.it/data/uploads/docs/3974EA7E-9E39-11EC-92F1-41634E5F79CB.pdf — § 241.6.7, pp. 22–23: posizione e regolazione del modulatore su motrici e rimorchi.

rows.text: In the lever-operated type, the load-sensing valve is fixed to the frame and linked to the axle: the change in distance indicates the load.
evidence: https://www.serformazione.it/data/uploads/docs/3974EA7E-9E39-11EC-92F1-41634E5F79CB.pdf — § 241.6.7, pp. 22–23: posizione e regolazione del modulatore su motrici e rimorchi.

rows.text: By varying pressure according to axle load, the load-sensing valve adjusts braking force between unladen and laden conditions.
evidence: https://www.serformazione.it/data/uploads/docs/3974EA7E-9E39-11EC-92F1-41634E5F79CB.pdf — § 241.6.7, pp. 22–23: posizione e regolazione del modulatore su motrici e rimorchi.
